feed.title: Claude expert to build a working copy of native.no
feed.description:
I'm hiring one person to build an MVP that replicates native.no. Go study that site before applying, it's the exact spec: a business owner enters their website URL, the product analyzes their business, generates a month of social posts (text + images) in their brand voice, and publishes approved posts to social channels after approval.

To be clear: this is a 1:1 functional copy. The functionality and features should be exactly what native.no offers, no more, no less. Organic social content only, no paid ads features.

MVP SCOPE (native.no's core loop)
- Landing page with signup, in our own brand and design
- URL in, brand and business analysis out
- Generation pipeline producing 30+ posts with images
- Simple dashboard: review, edit in plain language, approve
- Publishing to Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn via an aggregator API (Ayrshare or similar)
- Basic auth and billing (Stripe)

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

An expert with Claude or similar AI tools. You don't need a traditional dev background, you need to ship working products with Claude Code or comparable tooling and know the Claude API inside out. Stack is your call, I care about output.

The critical skill: taste in LLM outputs. Anyone can wire up an API call that produces content. I need someone who can look at 50 generated posts, see why they feel generic, and fix it through better prompting, examples and feedback loops. The product lives or dies on whether a business owner is proud to publish these posts. If your instinct is "the API returned text, ship it," this isn't for you.

STRUCTURE

Fixed price for the MVP. Ongoing work after that if it's good.

TO APPLY

1. Show me something that you have built.
2. Tell me one thing native.no does that will be hardest to replicate well, and why.
3. Offer your price and how long you'll need.

No generic cover letters.

siblingJobs.title: AI Video Editor for premium health brand (ongoing ad creative)
siblingJobs.description: LIGHT Health (lighthealth.co) is a premium consumer health brand: a clinical-grade at-home body scanner, $399, just launching in the US. Think Apple and Oura, not fitness or medical. We need ongoing short-form video ads for Meta. You take our scripts and turn them into scroll-stopping video: AI-actor UGC, B-roll with AI voiceover, mashups, demo and founder edits. Ongoing work, direct with the founder, fast iteration. The bar is hyper-realistic. AI content that does not look like AI. No uncanny faces, no robotic voiceover, no cheesy fitness energy. Premium, clinical, and honest, with no fake authority or unsupported health claims. What we look for: - A portfolio of short-form or UGC ads that look real and ad-ready. Direct-response, not brand films. - Fluency with AI video and voice tools (Arcads, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Runway, Kling) plus strong editing (CapCut, Premiere). - A feel for hooks and pacing, fast turnaround, and many variations from one concept. To apply: 1. Send 3+ video ads you have made. Say which parts were AI-generated and which tools you used. 2. One line on how you make AI footage look hyper-realistic. 3. If the work is strong, a small paid test clip, then ongoing volume.
